**Mortality Experience Study**（`arftonlum/MortalityLapseStudy`）**是一份**个人**寿险经验分析**项目****——**逐字自述为**「**This project is a personal actuarial project designed to analyze life insurance mortality and lapse experience using Python.**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**按最薄类目定向补**」**。

**可核实信息（均 2026-09-11 GitHub 接口与仓库实测）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 行业生命表的原件**随仓库**提供****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**仓库树**逐字**含 **`data/raw/PerLifeTables_F_Hist_TR2023.xlsx`（**1,549.1 KB**）**与 **`data/raw/PerLifeTables_M_Hist_TR2023.xlsx`（**1,543.1 KB**）**，**并含 **`data/processed/portfolio_with_qx.csv`（**364.3 KB**，**⭐ 文件名**逐字**表明**组合**带 **`qx`** 列）**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**最值得记**：**⭐ 即**经验分析**的**第一步**是**「**拿**哪张表**当**预期**」**——**⭐ 而**把**这张表**连同**组合**一起**放进仓库**，**意味着**别人**可以**复算**你的**A/E**，**而**不**必**猜**你**用的是**哪一版**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**做**经验分析**时**，**把**基准表**的**来源、**版本与**文件名**写清**，**比**在**正文**里**写**「**行业表**」**有用**得多**。

**⭐⭐ ② A/E 口径**写在**目标**里**，**而**不**在**代码**里**——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字列出**五个目标**（**逐字**：**Clean and explore insurance data**、**Compare observed mortality to an industry mortality table**、**Calculate Actual-to-Expected (A/E) ratios**、**Analyze lapse experience**、**Produce visualizations and a professional actuarial report**）**，**工具**逐字为 **Python、**pandas、**NumPy、**Matplotlib 与 **Git****；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一点**是**「**把**口径**前置**」**的**小型**范例**：**⭐ 即**先**说**「**我**怎么**算**A/E**」**，**再**说**「**我**用**什么**工具算**」**——**⭐ 顺序**反**过来**，**读者**就**只**知道**你**会**写 **pandas**。

**⭐⭐⭐ ③ ⚠️ 失效率笔记本**逐字为 **0.0 KB**，**而**目标列表里**有**它****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**仓库树**中 **`notebooks/`** 逐字**含四个**文件**：**`01_prepare_experience_dataset.ipynb`（**14.2 KB**）**、**`02_mortality_experience_analysis.ipynb`（**183.6 KB**）**、**`03_mortality_experience.ipynb`（**8.5 KB**）**、**⭐ **`04_lapse_experience.ipynb`（**0.0 KB**）****；**⭐ 本词条**如实指出**：**⭐ 即**这是**一份**「**完成了**一半**」**的工作**——**死亡率**分析**已**有**两个**笔记本（**其中**一个 **183.6 KB**，**含**输出**与**图表）**，**而**失效率**仍**是**空文件**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**这**正好**是**一个**真实**的**进度**样本**——**⭐ 若**你**把**自己**的**项目**放上 **GitHub**，**则**别人**会**用**你**的**文件**清单**判断**你**做到**哪一步**，**而**不**是**用**你**的**描述**；**⭐ 而**这一条**比**任何**「**接近**完成**」**的自述**更**可信**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 两处**工程痕迹**值得**如实**记下****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**仓库树**逐字**含 **`src/__pycache__/`** 下**六个 **`.pyc`**（**逐字**含 **cpython-314**，**即**环境**为 **Python 3.14）**、**一个**名为 **`src/_init_,py`** 的**文件**（**0.0 KB**）**，**以及**一个**逐字**拼写为 **`visualtization`** 的**模块**（**由 **`.pyc`** 名可见**）**；**⭐ 本词条**如实指出**：**⭐ 即 **`_init_,py`** 因**逗号**而**不**等于 **`__init__.py`**，**故**该目录**实际**上**不**是 **Python 包**——**⭐ 这**类**细节**通常**意味着**作者**还**在**本机**边**跑**边**改**，**而**不**是**按**发布**流程**整理**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**发布前**花**十分钟**清掉 **`__pycache__`**、**改对**文件名**，**就**能**让**仓库**从**「**练习**」**变**成**「**可**引用**」**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[mortsoa]] 与 **[[mortalitytables]] 覆盖**生命表**与 **SOA** 数据**、**[[expstudy]] 覆盖**经验研究**的**工具**、**[[actxps]] 覆盖**经验**分析**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**个人**级**的**寿险**经验分析**作品**＋**把**基准表**与**组合**一起**发布**」这一**形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **把**基准表**原件**随仓库**发布**；**② **先**写**口径**，**再**写**工具**；**③ **用**文件**清单**如实**反映**进度**（**空的**笔记本**就**是**空的**）**；**④ **发布前**清 **`__pycache__`**、**修**文件名**；**⑤ **产出**里**要有**一份**可读的**报告**，**而**不**只**是**代码**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有运行**其任何笔记本**（**未安装 **pandas／**NumPy／**Matplotlib**、**未打开**其 **Excel** 与 **CSV**）**，**故**不主张**其**A/E** 结果**、**不主张**其**可视化**与**报告**的**质量**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**仓库接口返回的元数据**、**README 全文**与**仓库树**（**文件名与**字节数**）**，**未读**其 **`src/*.py`** 源码**、**未读**其**笔记本**内容**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**其**行业生命表**的具体**来源与**版本口径**（**⭐ 只**从**文件名**读到 **`PerLifeTables`** 与 **`TR2023`**）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**组合数据的**来源**（**⭐ 逐字**只**说**为**个人**项目**，**未**说明**数据**是否**合成**）**——**⚠️ 本词条**因此**不**主张**其**数据**为**真实**业务**数据**。**⑤ ⚠️ 该仓库**无许可证文件**（**接口 `license` 字段为空**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 该作品**是**学习**与**作品集**项目**，**其**结果**不**构成**精算意见**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 與池內條目的關係**：[[mortsoa]]、[[mortalitytables]]、[[expstudy]]、[[actxps]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**個人級壽險經驗分析作品＋**基準表與組合一起發布**」**這一形態**。

e.body_en:
This is a personal life insurance experience study, stating in writing that it is a personal actuarial project for analysing life insurance mortality and lapse experience in Python. **This entry belongs to the round theme of targeted gap filling.**

**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-11 from the repository interface and the repository itself**:

**First, the industry life tables ship with the repository.** The tree contains one historical period life table file for each sex at roughly one and a half megabytes each, together with a processed portfolio file of about three hundred sixty kilobytes whose name indicates it carries a qx column. **The first question in any experience study is which table defines the expected basis, and shipping that table alongside the portfolio means a reader can recompute the ratios instead of guessing which vintage was used, so naming the source, version, and file of the benchmark is worth far more than saying industry table in prose.**

**Second, the actual-to-expected definition appears in the stated goals rather than only in code.** The description lists five goals: cleaning and exploring the insurance data, comparing observed mortality with an industry mortality table, calculating actual-to-expected ratios, analysing lapse experience, and producing visualisations together with a professional actuarial report, with the toolset given as Python, pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, and Git. **Stating how the ratio is defined before saying what computes it is the right order, because the reverse order tells a reader only that the author can write pandas.**

**Third, the lapse notebook is an empty file while the goals name lapse analysis.** The notebook directory holds four files, of which one prepares the experience dataset, one runs the mortality experience analysis at about one hundred eighty kilobytes, one is a shorter mortality notebook, and the fourth, on lapse experience, measures zero bytes. **This is an honest sample of work in progress, since mortality already has two notebooks including one with outputs and charts while lapse is not started, and a reader will judge progress from the file list rather than from the prose description, which makes this entry more credible than any claim of being nearly finished.**

**Fourth, two engineering traces are recorded as measured.** The tree contains six compiled bytecode caches under a source subdirectory, built by a recent interpreter version, a file whose name separates the two leading underscores with a comma so that it is not in fact an initialisation module, and a module name spelled with letters transposed. **A misspelled initialisation file means the directory is not really a package, and traces of this kind usually indicate that the author is iterating locally rather than following a release process, so ten minutes spent removing bytecode caches and correcting file names before publishing is what moves a repository from practice to citable.**

**Fifth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover life tables and industry data, an experience-study toolkit, and experience analysis, **while this entry supplies the form of an individual life experience study that publishes its benchmark table and portfolio together. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **five practices transfer: publish the benchmark table with the work; write the definition before the tools; let the file list tell the truth about progress, including an empty notebook; clean caches and fix file names before publishing; and include a readable report in the output rather than code alone.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, none of its notebooks was run**, no dependencies were installed and neither the spreadsheets nor the portfolio file were opened, **so no claim is made about its ratios, visualisations, or report quality**. **Second, only repository metadata, the description, and the file tree were read**, not the source modules or the notebook contents. **Third, the exact source and vintage basis of its industry life table were not verified**, only the file names being read. **Fourth, the origin of its portfolio data was not verified**, the text describing only a personal project, so this entry makes no claim that the data are real business data. **Fifth, the repository carries no licence file.
